Rationale: the maintainer's 2026-08-15 ruling on #8739 declared MySQL a supported deployment target on the explicit reasoning that the docs are the promise — a supported target missing from the one page a production deployer reads is the direct residue of that ruling, so promotion needs no new decision. Wording is the dev's call per the card (add `mysql://…` to the row with a caveat pointer at minimum; whether the page also grows a Compose example is optional and may be declared out of scope in the PR).

Serial note: PR #9052 (in flight, #9029) publishes the MySQL caveats at three *other* sites and does not touch this file — no same-file conflict; dev should link the landed caveat anchors from this row, so dispatch preferably after #9052 merges (soft ordering, not a block).

Size/model suggestion: S; sonnet.
